notes.title: ANIME STANDING in now on gamepad & bugs fix!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881841/66a518f1379f15e2ad898b29fe3876da327104d3.png[/img]

After seeing some of the bugs messages popping out in our community, we share the same annoyance you are having.. And it just wouldn’t do! So we fixed those, plus added a few extras here and there:

[list]
[*]access the [b]cybertruck[/b] easily after all the missions end — the vehicle won't disappear anywhere from the very last base
[*]the [b]graphic settings[/b] in your game will be set as 'max' by default
[*][b]mouse sensitivity [/b]is now under your control (check game's 'Settings'), along with the 'inverted mouse' option
[*][b]music settings[/b] also became more flexible: now you can change things up both from the 'Pause' and 'Settings'
[*]you have a choice to turn the [b]'Motion Blur'[/b] on/off
[/list]

[h2]And the best thing as of now: ANIME STANDING now fully supports the gamepad![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881841/b2444f76b618687fa4ce80301c772aab1ddba848.png[/img]

Additionally, we would like to remind you that this game features [b]free Nudity DLC[/b] if case you've missed it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309110/ANIME_STANDING__Nudity_DLC_18/

We wish you the best gaming!

Cheers, 
Konnichiwa Games

notes.content:
[h3]Hey everybody! [/h3]

Our 18+ DLC was just approved! We didn’t want to release the game without it so had to postpone it one more time, unfortunately.

The release is happening tomorrow and there is nothing that can stop us this time :) 

The price will be set at $1 for the game itself, and the [b]18+ DLC will be FREE[/b]!
[h3]
Cheers,
Konnichiwa Games[/h3]

notes.title: ANIME STANDING finally coming soon!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

[h3]Hope you're all doing well during these times.[/h3]

Our apologies for a long silence in releasing the game! Anime Standing was a long awaited project, which release date we had to postpone for quite a while, unfortunately.

Regardless, we are now happy to inform that we are currently on a stage of working on fine details. And we have already sent the game for a review. It is now better, more grand and complex!

Despite how long it’d been, we plan to release Anime Standing on [b]1st of May[/b]. It’s only just a little more time before the game will be finally available!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/16Sqycb.gif[/img]

[h3]Add the game to your Steam Wishlist and leave your feedback!

Stay safe,
Konnichiwa Games[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253870/ANIME_STANDING/
